2608.04147.title: LiNC: Lightweight Noise Correction via Per-Sample Trust and Gaussian Mixture Modeling
2608.04147.paper_summary: Label noise is common in medical imaging datasets due to factors such as inter-rater variability, annotation errors, and ambiguous cases. This can severely undermine the reliability and clinical effectiveness of machine learning models trained using those datasets. To address this challenge, we introduce Lightweight Noise Correction (LiNC), which adds a single trainable trust parameter per training sample and learns when to use the observed label and when to defer to the model during a standard training loop. The key idea is to train using a convex combination of the observed label and the model's own predictive distribution, controlled by a per-sample trust parameter. We show that the gradient of this objective drives trust values in opposite directions for clean versus noisy samples in the early training phase, yielding separable trust distributions. We use a 3-component Gaussian Mixture Model over the trust values to separate them into clean, ambiguous, and noisy cases and then execute a short soft-correction phase on the noisy cases and a final hard correction phase. Experiments on ten 2D datasets from MedMNISTv2 under label noise of up to 50% show consistent gains in accuracy and strong mislabel detection. LiNC adds negligible asymptotic overhead: the training-time complexity remains dominated by the base network, with additional memory growing linearly with the size of the training set.
2608.04147.paper_summary_zh: 標籤噪聲在醫學影像數據集中很常見，這是由於評估者之間的變異性、註釋錯誤和模糊案例等因素造成的。這可能會嚴重削弱使用這些數據集訓練的機器學習模型的可靠性和臨床有效性。為了解決這一挑戰，我們引入了輕量級噪聲校正（LiNC），它為每個訓練樣本添加了一個可訓練的信任參數，並學習在標準訓練循環中何時使用觀察到的標籤，以及何時依賴模型。其關鍵思想是使用觀察到的標籤和模型自身的預測分佈的凸組合進行訓練，該組合由每個樣本的信任參數控制。我們展示了這一目標的梯度在早期訓練階段對於乾淨樣本和噪聲樣本的信任值驅動相反的方向，從而產生可分離的信任分佈。我們使用三組分量的高斯混合模型對信任值進行分類，將其分為乾淨、模糊和噪聲案例，然後對噪聲案例執行短暫的軟校正階段和最終的硬校正階段。在MedMNISTv2的十個2D數據集上進行的實驗，在標籤噪聲高達50%的情況下顯示出一致的準確性增益和強大的錯誤標記檢測。LiNC增加的漸進開銷微不足道：訓練時間的複雜性仍然由基本網絡主導，額外的內存隨著訓練集的大小線性增長。
